公司簡介
CORPORATE PROFILE


華潤水泥控股有限公司於二零零三年三月十三日根據開曼群島公司法在開曼群島註冊成立為一
家獲豁免的有限公司，並為華潤集團所有水泥及混凝土業務的控股公司。

本公司曾於二零零三年七月二十九日以介紹形式在香港聯合交易所有限公司主板上市。於二零
零六年，本公司被華潤（集團）有限公司私有化成為順創投資有限公司（現稱華潤集團（水泥）有限
公司）的全資附屬公司，並於二零零六年七月二十六日撤銷其股份在聯交所的上市地位。

本公司於二零零九年十月六日以全球發售形式重新於聯交所主板上市。於本報告日期，本公司
已發行股份總數為6,982,937,817股，其中華潤集團持有約68.72%的本公司已發行股份。

China Resources Cement Holdings Limited was incorporated on 13 March 2003 in the Cayman Islands as an
exempted company with limited liability under the Companies Law of the Cayman Islands and is the holding
company of all the cement and concrete operations of China Resources Group.


The Company was listed on the main board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited on 29 July 2003 by way
of introduction. In 2006, the Company was privatized as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Smooth Concept Investments
Limited (currently known as CRH (Cement) Limited) by China Resources (Holdings) Company Limited and the listing
of the Company’s shares on the Stock Exchange was withdrawn on 26 July 2006.


The Company was re-listed on the main board of the Stock Exchange on 6 October 2009 by way of a global offering.
As at the date of this report, the total number of issued shares of the Company was 6,982,937,817 shares, of which
China Resources Group is holding approximately 68.72% of the issued shares of the Company.

主要風險及不明朗因素                                      PRINCIPAL RISKS AND UNCERTAINTIES

水泥及混凝土是基礎設施、房地產建設及農村                            Cement and concrete are the main and basic building materials for
發展的主要基礎建築材料。水泥消費量與經濟                            infrastructure projects, property construction and rural development.
發展及固定資產投資高度相關。水泥及混凝土                            Cement consumption is highly correlated to economic development and
是重量較大的建築材料，生產商在區域市場內                            FAI. As cement and concrete are relatively heavyweight building materials,

註:                       notes:


1.   自華潤電力集團購買電力         1.       Purchase of electricity from CR Power Group


     於二零一七年十一月一日，本公司與華            On 1 November 2017, the Company entered into an agreement
     潤電力控股有限公司就本集團透過華             with China Resources Power Holdings Company Limited for
     潤電力集團購買電力訂立協議，包括但            the purchase of electricity by the Group from CR Power Group,
     不限於直接供電（華潤電力集團發電進            including but not limited to direct power supply (where CR Power
     行供電）及代理供電（華潤電力集團購            Group generates the electricity to be supplied) and agency power
     電向本集團進行供電），由二零一八年            supply (where CR Power Group purchases the electricity for
     一月一日至二零二零年十二月三十一             supply to the Group), for the term of three years from 1 January
     日止為期三年。該協議將有助本集團以            2018 to 31 December 2020. The agreement would enable
     公平、合理及有競爭力並與一般電網電            the Group to secure electricity supply at a fair, reasonable and
     費較低的價格獲得電力供應，因而有助            competitive price which is lower than the normal on-grid tariffs,
     降低本集團的運營成本。根據該協議，            which in turn reduces operating costs of the Group. Under the
     本集團應付的電費將根據國家及省份             agreement, the electricity fees payable by the Group would be
     供電系統改革政策，並參考公開巿場價            determined after arm’s length negotiation in accordance with
     格，經公平磋商後釐定，且不遜於與其            the relevant national and provincial power supply system reform
     他獨立第三方類似交易之價格。由於華            policies and with reference to prices in the open market, which
     潤（集團）同時為華潤電力控股有限公            shall be no less favourable than the price for similar transactions

董事局負責指引本公司的策略性目標及監管       The Board is responsible for directing the strategic objectives and
業務的管理。董事負責促進本公司業務順利進      overseeing the management of the business of the Company. The
展及客觀地作出符合本公司最佳利益的決策。      Directors are accountable for promoting the success of the Company and
                          making decisions objectively in the best interests of the Company.

為保持高效率運作和經營決策的靈活性與迅       In order to maintain highly efficient operation, as well as flexibility and
捷性，董事局必要時亦將其管理及行政權力轉      swiftness in operational decision-making, the Board, when necessary, may
授予管理層，並就授權行為提供清晰的指示，      delegate its managing and administrative powers to the management,
以避免嚴重妨礙或削弱董事局履行其職權的       and provide clear directions regarding such delegation so as to avoid
整體能力。轉授予董事局轄下各委員會的職責      seriously impeding or undermining the overall capabilities of the Board in
及權力詳載於下文各部份。              exercising its powers. Duties and authorities delegated to the various board
                          committees are described in the respective sections below.

董事局應根據本公司業務所需而具備適當的       The Board should have a balance of skills and experience appropriate for
技巧和經驗。執行董事及非執行董事的組合應      the requirements of the business of the Company. A balanced composition
保持平衡，以確保董事局的獨立性並可令董事      of executive Directors and non-executive Directors helps to ensure the
局作出有效的獨立判斷。董事局的運作和管理      independence of the Board and enables the Board to make independent
以及本公司業務的日常管理應在董事局的層       judgments effectively. The operation and management of the Board and
面清晰劃分，以確保權力及授權的平衡，而權      the day-to-day management of the Company’s business should be clearly
力不會集中於任何個人。               divided at the Board level to ensure that there is a balance of power and
                          authority and that power will not be concentrated on any one individual.

主席及總裁的角色及職能                                       ROLES AND FUNCTIONS OF CHAIRMAN AND
                                                  CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

主席                                                Chairman


主席與總裁的職權乃分開的。主席批准及監管                              The roles of the Chairman are segregated from the Chief Executive Officer.
本公司的策略及政策、年度預算及業務規劃，                              The Chairman approves and monitors the Company’s strategies and
評估本公司的表現及監督本公司的管理。                                policies, annual budgets and business plans, evaluates the performance
                                                  of the Company, and supervises the management of the Company.


該等責任的劃分亦有助加強其獨立性及問責                               Such division of responsibilities also helps to reinforce their independence
性。主席負責領導及監察董事局的職能，以確                              and accountability. The Chairman is responsible for providing leadership
保其表現符合本集團的最佳利益，及董事局會                              to, and overseeing the functioning of, the Board to ensure that it acts
議有計劃及有效地舉行。主席亦負責為每次董                              in the best interests of the Group and that Board meetings are planned
事局會議設定議程，當中已考慮過董事及公司                              and conducted in an effective manner. The Chairman is also responsible
秘書所建議的事宜（如適用）。在執行董事及公                             for setting the agenda for each Board meeting upon considering, where
司秘書的支持下，主席力求確保全體董事適時                              appropriate, matters proposed by the Directors and the Company
獲悉於董事局會議上列舉的問題和及時地獲                               Secretary. With the support of executive Director(s) and the Company
得充分而準確、清晰、完備及可靠的資訊。主                              Secretary, the Chairman seeks to ensure that all Directors are properly
席亦積極鼓勵董事著手處理董事局的事務及                               informed of issues arising at Board meetings and provided in a timely
促進董事局的職能。主席每年與獨立非執行董                              manner with adequate information which is accurate, clear, complete
事舉行不少於一次沒有其他董事出席的當面                               and reliable. The Chairman also actively encourages the Directors to be

3.   重大會計政策               3.   SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES

     綜合財務報表已根據香港會計師公會          The consolidated financial statements have been prepared in
     頒佈的香港財務報告準則編製。此外，         accordance with HKFRSs issued by the HKICPA. In addition, the
     綜合財務報表包括香港聯合交易所有          consolidated financial statements include applicable disclosures
     限公司證券上市規則及香港公司條例          required by the Rules Governing the Listing of Securities on The
     所規定的適用披露事項。               Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited and by the Hong Kong
                               Companies Ordinance.


     綜合財務報表已按歷史成本基準編製，         The consolidated financial statements have been prepared on
     惟投資物業、按公平價值計入其他全面         the historical cost basis, except for investment property, equity
     收益的權益投資及若干應收貿易賬款          investment designated at fair value through other comprehensive
     按公平價值計量除外（請參閱下文所載         income and certain trade receivables, which have been measured
     會計政策）
         。                     at fair value, as explained in the accounting policies set out below.


     歷史成本一般根據貨物交換所得代價          Historical cost is generally based on the fair value of the
     的公平價值而釐定。                 consideration given in exchange for goods.


     公平價值是於計量日市場參與者於有          Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or
     秩序交易中出售資產可收取或轉讓負          paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market
     債須支付的價格，而不論該價格是否可         participants at the measurement date, regardless of whether that
     使用其他估值方法直接可觀察或估計。         price is directly observable or estimated using another valuation
     於估計資產或負債的公平價值時，本集         technique. In estimating the fair value of an asset or a liability, the
     團會考慮市場參與者於計量日對資產          Group takes into account the characteristics of the asset or liability
     或負債定價時所考慮的資產或負債特          if market participants would take those characteristics into account
     點。該等綜合財務報表中作計量及╱或         when pricing the asset or liability at the measurement date. Fair
     披露用途的公平價值乃按此基準釐定，         value for measurement and/or disclosure purposes in these
     惟香港財務報告準則第2號範圍內的以         consolidated financial statements is determined on such a basis,
     股份支付交易、香港財務報告準則第16        except for share-based payment transactions that are within the
     號範圍內的租賃交易，以及與公平價值         scope of HKFRS 2, leasing transactions that are within the scope
     相似但並非公平價值的項目計量（例如         of HKFRS 16, and measurements that have some similarities to
     香港會計準則第2號的可變現淨值或香         fair value but are not fair value, such as net realizable value in
     港會計準則第36號的使用價值）除外。        HKAS 2 or value in use in HKAS 36.
